title: OutBlocks: Simply Better
body:
The simple way to make Minecraft better.

Same vibe, same blocks, same game… but it’s not.

Everything’s smoother, cleaner, more fun to play.
You won’t notice every change right away, but you’ll feel it.

The lag is gone. The controls make sense. Your inventory finally listens to you.

![Steaks never been higher!](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/043d8942d2d978c39c61060f0e2545c2ca9c6c45.png)

It’s just… Minecraft, finally doing what it should’ve done all along.

Plug and play. No nonsense.

![SBT](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/88058c34eaacfe64cf64013afa2e2bcbc41922b8.jpeg)


Nerds down here!
 
✦ Fully optimized engine: rendering, lighting, chunk loading, entity processing  
✦ Designed for multiplayer: voice chat, smoother connections, advanced LAN support  
✦ Clean, focused UI upgrades: smarter tooltips, faster navigation  
✦ Quality of life improvements everywhere: inventory, controls, accessibility  

Built to feel like a "Vanilla Update", faster, smoother, and quietly more capable.

Still remaining our favorite game, Minecraft... Just Simply Better
